title: a fixture naming a choice the request cannot serve is an invalid stub response
note: Derived from §13.2 and §43.4, not from §44. The selected choice MUST exist as a key in the request question's criteria object. It does not, so response generation fails after the stub was selected — the invocation still counts. The detailed cause goes to stderr and is deliberately not in the wire body (§43.4).

body.message: Configured stub cannot produce a valid response for this request.

journal._timestampOmitted: timestamp is diagnostic only (§8.6, §41.7) and is not asserted

conventions.comparison: parsed JSON values; object key order and insignificant number spelling 1 versus 1.0 are not significant (§44 preamble, §39.4)
conventions.messageSentinel: the literal string <not asserted> marks a field whose value the specification does not freeze; a runner MUST skip it
